title: Add Tdarr Matrix 100 Percent Run
summary: Add an explicit Tdarr Matrix full-library sample-processing preset for final proof runs across every generated Movie and TV source path.
reason: The 30-file matrix is representative coverage, but operators need a separate 100 percent proof run that processes every downloaded Tdarr sample in both generated library views.
behavior_before: Diagnostics offered report, 6-file smoke, 30-file matrix, and strict report gates. The run-samples tool selected deterministic subsets only unless exact case keys were supplied.
behavior_after: Diagnostics includes an explicit 100 percent matrix action that tells the backend audit tool to select every manifest row into a fresh isolated TdarrMatrixRuns root.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_service_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies the full preset emits --all-samples and is included in timeout sizing
tests/python/tooling/test_tdarr_matrix_audit.py verifies select_all_sample_rows keeps every manifest row in deterministic bucket order
tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py verifies the Run 100% Matrix button and label are present
rollback_plan: Remove the full preset, --all-samples selector, WebView button/label, contract updates, and tests; refresh summaries and rerun targeted Tdarr diagnostics tests.
notes:
Full matrix processing is intentionally explicit because it can run for a long time. It must still use isolated TdarrMatrixRuns roots and must not mutate the canonical Tdarr cache.
Added explicit Tdarr Matrix full-library action with --all-samples selection and WebView button.
Registered generated summaries refreshed for the Tdarr Matrix 100 percent run change.
Final change-control coverage failure was unrelated to this packet: MP-CHANGE-2026-0605-010 missing date_completed plus the existing nine uncovered dirty files under dependency-atlas subtitle images, MP-CHANGE-2026-0607-020 summary, and core/kernel dto_status/models_core files and summaries.
